We need to produce a test class for getSchemaType method. Should test that schemaType is set correctly based on schemaNode. Need to construct TypeValidator with appropriate parameters. Use mocks for JsonSchema, ValidationContext, etc. Also need JsonNode for schemaNode representing type. Use Jackson's JsonNodeFactory to create ObjectNode with "type": "string" etc. Then instantiate TypeValidator and assert getSchemaType returns expected JsonType (enum). Need import JsonNodeFactory, ObjectNode, JsonNode, JsonType.

Also need to handle Union type: schemaNode with "type": ["string","null"] maybe leads to JsonType.UNION? TypeFactory.getSchemaNodeType determines. We'll just test simple types and union.

We must not invoke private methods. Use public constructor.

Set up ValidationContext: need URIFactory, URNFactory, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory, SchemaValidatorsConfig. Can mock those using Mockito.

Simplify: mock ValidationContext and stub getConfig() to return new SchemaValidatorsConfig (default). Also need metaSchema, etc. Provide null for others? The constructor requires non-null URIFactory, URNFactory, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory, SchemaValidatorsConfig. We can mock each interface/class.

Create mocks: URIFactory uriFactory = mock(URIFactory.class); URNFactory urnFactory = mock(URNFactory.class); JsonMetaSchema metaSchema = mock(JsonMetaSchema.class); JsonSchemaFactory jsonSchemaFactory = mock(JsonSchemaFactory.class); SchemaValidatorsConfig config = new SchemaValidatorsConfig(); ValidationContext validationContext = new ValidationContext(uriFactory, urnFactory, metaSchema, jsonSchemaFactory, config);

Also need JsonSchema parentSchema: mock(JsonSchema.class).

Now create schemaNode: ObjectNode schemaNode = JsonNodeFactory.instance.objectNode(); schemaNode.put("type","string");

Instantiate TypeValidator: new TypeValidator("schemaPath", schemaNode, parentSchema, validationContext);

Then assert validator.getSchemaType() == JsonType.STRING.

Similarly test union: schemaNode.putArray("type").add("string").add("null"); Expect JsonType.UNION.

Use @BeforeEach to create validationContext and parentSchema.
